title: An AI coding agent, used to write code, needs to reduce your maintenance costs
summary: James Shore discusses how AI coding agents should be evaluated not just for their code-writing abilities but for their impact on long-term maintenance costs, which typically represent 40-80% of total software development expenses. The article argues that most AI coding tools optimize for short-term productivity but create technical debt that increases future maintenance burden.
problem_solved: Addresses the misalignment between AI coding tools that boost immediate productivity but increase long-term code maintenance costs.
why_valuable: Maintenance costs dominate software budgets, so AI tools that reduce maintenance burden provide exponentially greater ROI than those that just speed up initial development.
